content.text: Most commonly into neck into carotid area and down left sternal border, possibly apex
Toward the left upper neck and shoulder areas
Blowing and can be harsh in sound quality
Usually to left axilla, LSB, and base
May radiate to LSB and MCL but not to axilla
Low and best heard with bell
May radiate across precordium but not to axilla
High, best auscultated with diaphragm unless client is sitting up and leaning forward
May radiate to 2nd ICS, RSB and may proceed to apex
Expiration may intensify the murmur if the client leans forward and sits up
May radiate to 2nd ICS, RSB and may proceed to apex
